verdict.rationale: Persona documents a sandbox mode where no real verifications are performed. It has a toggle to force passes or fails so you can test all possible states of an integration, and Simulate Actions that programmatically trigger Inquiry and Verification lifecycle behavior for integration testing. That covers deterministic pass and fail outcomes. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that a 'needs review' outcome can be forced in sandbox, enumeration of the specific simulate actions or test values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
